subject: Accelerated New Growth Tax Assessment Adoption
overview: The Council voted to adopt a local option state law to accelerate tax assessments for new real estate construction and approved the warrant for the November 2023 municipal election. The meeting was dedicated to the memory of former Assistant City Clerk Dorothy L. Donaghy.

items.title: Centenarian Congratulations
items.summary: Approved resolutions congratulating Mary Terry and Rita Tomololo on their 100th birthdays.

items.title: In Memoriam: Dorothy L. Donaghy
items.summary: Approved a moment of silence and dedicated the meeting to the memory of longtime Assistant City Clerk Dorothy L. Donaghy.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved meeting records from September 19 and October 3, 2023.

items.title: Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved reports regarding road issues, progress on the budget ordinance, and updates to the draft tree ordinance.

items.title: Route 16 Guardrail Replacement
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the Department of Conservation and Recreation replace a damaged guardrail at Route 16 and Auburn Street.

items.title: Adoption of Accelerated New Growth Tax Provisions
items.summary: Approved the adoption of Massachusetts General Law Chapter 59, Section 2A, to reduce the time lag for assessing taxes on new real estate improvements.

items.title: November 2023 Municipal Election Warrant
items.summary: Approved the official warrant for the November 7 municipal election and authorized the Chief of Police to designate polling location staffing.
